note.name: Saltmere offer.md
note.summary: A map designer offer from Mosswing Studio, with an office beside Saltmere station.
note.body:
Mosswing Studio offers Alex a map designer role, dated 2026-10-06. The office is beside Saltmere station.

See also [[Job hunt]]: the role search this offer belongs to.
See also [[Flat hunt]]: the shortlist is near the same station.

lines.text: The new map designer offer has an office beside Saltmere station.
The new offer places the office beside the station used for the flat shortlist.
